**Building the future of live entertainment** — you're not watching, you're
in it. Living worlds an audience helps shape, piloted into any place: a
venue, a live stream, a home.

Infinite Spaces is a marketplace for living worlds. Creators author participatory experiences in Playbox — worlds an audience helps shape — and run them live in venues, streams, and homes. A two-person crew produces what used to take a full production team.

Live/TV broadcast and site production. The person who turns the platform into
actual shows — owns run-of-show, crew, vendors, venue and site logistics, and
the production side of live and broadcast events. Bridges the technical team and
the real-world constraints of a show night.

## What You'll Do

- Production management — run-of-show, scheduling, crew and vendor coordination,
  budgets
- Executive production — live and TV/broadcast events end to end; site build and
  on-site production
- The technical-to-show bridge — translates between the engineering team and the
  operational reality of a live event

## What We're Looking For

a track record producing live and/or broadcast events at scale;
network in the live-events technical community (a sourcing surface for Roles 1–7,
per Sourcing); calm under show-night pressure.

## Benefits

- Competitive Seattle salary and meaningful early equity
- Equity-heavy structures available before cash is fully in place, with an honest timeline to when salary normalizes
- Health, dental, and vision coverage
- A small team where everyone owns real surface area and your work ships

*You're not watching. You're in it.*
